overview: The committee reviewed the 2025 Annual Surveillance Report from the Medford Police Department, focusing on body-worn camera data, privacy safeguards, and the use of external surveillance technologies. The committee discussed the impact of these tools on the community before approving the report.

items.title: 2025 Annual Surveillance Report
items.summary: Police Chief Jack Buckley presented the report, noting that the department recorded over 32,000 body-worn camera videos in 2025 and utilizes external data like Flock cameras and facial recognition for serious investigations despite not owning the equipment. Councilors and public commenters questioned the department on data retention, the process for auditing officer compliance, and the methodology for assessing whether surveillance technology disproportionately impacts specific demographic groups. Approved the report and kept the paper in committee.
